formula: high * context + elevation + slope + lon + lat + lon^2 + lat^2 + lon*lat + annual_temperature + log1p(annual_precipitation) + C(2018_grid_modal_landcover) + C(year)
covariate_scaling: continuous predictors centered and scaled in complete-case low/high fit sample
landcover: new 2018 MCD12Q1.061 native categories aggregated by spatial mode, not original averaged category codes
climate: WorldClim v1 1960-1990 independent long-term background; not event-anomaly reference
uncertainty: grid-cluster sandwich conditional on empirical standardization distribution; cross-grid spatial dependence remains
distance_inputs: original manuscript panel; corrected-distance sensitivity separate
